names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 21 decembrie, «Sfânta Muceniță Iuliana din Nicomidia».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Δεκεμβρίου, «Αγία Ιουλιανή», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s first heading for 21. децембар ст. ст., „Света мученица Јулијана и шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом.“ — «Света» is “saint” and not a rank, «мученица» is the rank `martyr` the folder already carries, and the rest of the heading is the company that believed at her wonder and not any part of her name, so the bare forename is what is left. The book gives her no by-name: Nicomedia is in the body as her birthplace and not in the heading, and a form was not assembled out of it. MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN, AND IT LANDS ON ANOTHER FOLDER: `juliana-of-ptolemais` already carries the identical Serbian string, so the fold key «јулијана» is declared in the same commit with both holders read. That other woman is the martyr of Ptolemais, dated about 273, kept by this same book on the Julian 4 March with Paul of Ptolemais and the three executioners who were converted at her suffering — thirty years and a different province and a different company.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 21 decembrie — «Sfânta Muceniță Iuliana din Nicomidia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Αγία Ιουλιανή»

attestations.note: The life page `/2816/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian, and the entry is the same woman: the virgin martyr who refused Eleusios, was burned in the face with heated iron and beheaded. **The two sources differ about the city.** The Romanian form the folder holds, and the English display name with it, call her of Nicomedia; saint.gr makes Eleusios «κάποιο διακεκριμένο αξιωματούχο της Αντιόχειας», a distinguished official of Antioch, and names no city of hers at all. That is recorded, not resolved, and the display name is left as it stands. The same page keeps her synaxis «στο μαρτύριο αυτής, πλησίον της μάρτυρος Ευφημίας στο Πέτριο» — at her martyrion near the martyr Euphemia at Petrion, which is a place and not a relation, so no `related` row is made to any of the corpus's four Euphemias. No years are given anywhere on the page, so no `dates` key is drafted and the folder's null is left alone. One apolytikion is printed with its ἦχος and its automelon and names her; it is taken. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 03.01.2026 (21. децембар ст. ст.) — „Света мученица Јулијана и шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, and the fullest of the three. Identified on the whole dossier and on the same menologion day the Romanian and Greek already keep her: the virgin of Nicomedia born of pagan parents, betrothed to the senator Елевсије whom she put off by asking that he first be made eparch of the city, who was made eparch by flattery and bribes, and to whom she then said „Шта нам вреди бити телесно уједињени а духом раздељени?“ — what good is it to us to be joined in body and parted in spirit. Her own father mocked and beat her and handed her to the eparch; she was scourged, thrown bloodied into prison, healed there by the Lord and shown whole before him, then cast into a heated furnace that did not burn her. THE HEADING’S «шест стотина тридесет мученика с њом» IS THE 630 WHO BELIEVED AT THAT WONDER, and the body divides them exactly as the corpus already does — «пет стотина мушких и стотину тридесет женских» — so `five-hundred-martyrs-of-nicomedia` and `hundred-and-thirty-women-martyrs` take rows of their own off this same heading and the `related` rows the three already carry stand. THE YEAR IS NEW TO THE CORPUS: «304. године», and this folder had NO `dates` object at all, so a death of 304 is written where there was nothing. WHAT ELSE THE ENTRY GIVES, and goes into the life: that she heard the gospel preaching from somebody and turned to Christ with her whole heart; that she went to the block joyful, prayed on her knees and laid her own head on it; and that Елевсије was soon overtaken by the judgement of God, his ship broken at sea, who did not drown but swam to an island where dogs tore him and ate him. The Serbian form is the heading’s bare forename; it lands on `juliana-of-ptolemais`, which already holds the identical string, so the two-member fold key «јулијана» is declared in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in this same commit with both holders read. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

hymns.text: Ὡς νύμφη πανάμωμος καὶ ἀθληφόρος σεμνή, τῷ Λόγῳ νενύμφευσαι τοῦ ἀθανάτου Πατρός, Ἰουλιανὴ ἔνδοξε, σὺ γὰρ φθαρτὸν μνηστήρα παριδοῦσα, ἐμφρόνως ἤθλησας ὑπὲρ φύσιν καὶ τὸν ὄφιν καθεῖλες· καὶ νῦν ταῖς τοῦ νυμφίου σου τρυφᾶς φαιδρότησι.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the one hymn on the page of «Αγία Ιουλιανή», and it names her.

english.text: As a bride wholly without blemish and a modest bearer of the contest, you were betrothed to the Word of the immortal Father, glorious Juliana; for having passed over a perishable suitor you contended wisely beyond nature and brought the serpent down, and now you delight in the splendours of your bridegroom.

death.note: Охридски пролог за 21. децембар ст. ст.: «душа оде у царство вечне Христове светлости, 304. године». This folder held no `dates` object of any kind before, neither doxologia nor saint.gr having given a year; one book, one year, nothing to reconcile and nothing inferred. The book gives no year of birth. THE SAME YEAR WAS DELIBERATELY NOT WRITTEN ONTO THE TWO COMPANIES of the same entry: the sentence attaches it to her beheading, and that they died in the same hour is the narrative’s order and not a year the page states for them.
